correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 35 XOR-line triples on labels 1..15 and every one of 32767 nonempty subsets: exactly 3048 permitted faces and f-vector (15,105,420,945,1008,420,120,15), with 168 maximal 5-caps and 15 maximal 8-caps in the source. Reconstructed the full greedy coordinate-toggle matching of 1484 incidence pairs and topologically sorted all 13770 incidence arcs on 3048 cells (acyclic). Critical cells are one 0-cell, one 3-cell (mask 534) and 78 4-cells. Computed signed gradient-path projection to the unique critical 3-cell independently: the integer Morse attaching row has 15 entries -2, 44 zeros and 19 entries +2, gcd 2. A CW complex with those critical cells is a 3-sphere plus 78 4-cells attached by integer degrees; unimodular column reduction leaves degree-2 Moore attachment and 77 null attaching maps. Therefore the claimed integral homotopy type follows, not just its mod-two Betti numbers. This finite calculation is exhaustive by bounded 15-point domain.
